# Foldline

> Foldline is a free, open source Dynamic Island for Windows 10 and 11: a small black pill at the top of the screen that opens into pages such as media controls with synced lyrics, a calendar and system stats. It is written in Rust, has no accounts or paid tier, and contacts no Foldline server.

Foldline is licensed GPL-3.0-or-later. The name and logo are not under the code license.

## Facts

- Price: free, with no paid tier, in-app purchase or advertising.
- Platform: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. Windows only.
- Latest version: 0.6.0, released 23 November 2026. Installer size 5.76 MB.
- Pages: media, shelf, calendar, focus timer, todo, prayer times, weather, system stats, clipboard, device batteries. A page is what the open notch shows.
- Activities in the collapsed pill (an activity is what the pill shows while something happens, then goes away): volume and brightness, battery, Bluetooth devices, microphone and camera in use, Caps Lock, Windows notifications, browser downloads.
- Extensible: a contributor can add a page, an activity or a page's settings in its own folder and send a pull request.
- Installer: not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC". Choose More info, then Run anyway. Releases are published on GitHub only; Foldline is not on the Microsoft Store.

## Performance

Measured on 22 November 2026 on Windows 11 with a Ryzen 5 8645HS, as a release build with the shelf page open (one run on one PC):

- Memory at start: 23.8 MB.
- CPU while idle: 0 %.
- CPU per open and close: 116 ms.
- Memory growth over 10 open and close cycles: 0.3 MB.

Music playback and live lyrics were not measured.

## Privacy

The app has no account, no sign-in and no analytics. Settings, the todo list and the shelf stay in `%APPDATA%\Foldline`. Data leaves the PC only when a feature needs it:

- Check for updates: GitHub, only when you click the button on the About page.
- Synced lyrics: track details to LRCLIB.
- Calendar: your iCal link, every 15 minutes.
- Weather: your chosen place to MET Norway, only while the Weather page is on.

The website counts visits with PostHog in cookieless mode, stores nothing on your device and has no cookie banner.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fold.hibatillah.com/): overview, the notch anatomy, open and collapsed states, features and FAQ.
- [Home in Indonesian](https://fold.hibatillah.com/id): the same page in Bahasa Indonesia.
- [Releases](https://fold.hibatillah.com/releases): what changed in each version, in plain words.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fold.hibatillah.com/privacy): what the website and the app collect.
- [Terms of Service](https://fold.hibatillah.com/terms): license, trademark and warranty terms.

## Page details

Each page has its own page on the website, in English and, under `/id`, in Indonesian:

- [Media and lyrics](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/media): the playing track, its controls and synced lyrics, from any player in the Windows media controls.
- [File shelf](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/shelf): drop files and pick them up later, twelve at most.
- [Calendar](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/calendar): events from an iCal link, by month or by week, with a reminder in the collapsed pill.
- [Focus timer](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/timer): a focus timer with short and long breaks, with a ring in the collapsed pill.
- [Todo](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/todo): a list with no limit. It has no collapsed view and no settings.
- [Prayer times](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/prayer): prayer times for any city, calculated on your PC, with a countdown in the collapsed pill.
- [Weather](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/weather): the next hours or days from MET Norway, with a rain alert in the collapsed pill.
- [System stats](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/stats): CPU, memory, GPUs, network and disks at a glance. It has no collapsed view.
- [Clipboard](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/clipboard): your last seven copies, kept in memory only.
- [Device batteries](https://fold.hibatillah.com/pages/devices): the battery of your Bluetooth and 2.4 GHz receiver devices.

## Source and downloads

- [Source code](https://github.com/hibatillah/foldline): the full code, under GPL-3.0-or-later.

- [Contributing](https://github.com/hibatillah/foldline/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): the contributor agreement and how to add your own content.
